note: Researched by Gemini (Google Search grounding), then fact-checked and link-corrected by Claude before publishing.

items.title: OpenAI previews GPT-5.6 'Sol' with stronger cyber skills
items.summary: OpenAI's new GPT-5.6 'Sol' is its most capable model yet, especially at finding and fixing security flaws. Early access is limited at the US government's request.

items.title: Microsoft launches 7 in-house MAI models at Build 2026
items.summary: Microsoft unveiled seven of its own AI models — including MAI-Thinking-1 for reasoning and MAI-Code-1 for coding — as it reduces its reliance on OpenAI.

items.title: Claude joins Slack as a shared AI teammate
items.summary: Anthropic's new 'Claude Tag' puts one @Claude in a Slack channel the whole team can direct. It remembers past chats and can follow up on tasks on its own.

items.title: NVIDIA releases Nemotron 3 Ultra open model
items.summary: A 550B-parameter open model (55B active) built for AI agents. NVIDIA says it runs long, multi-step tasks up to 5x faster and cheaper than similar open models.

items.title: Apple unveils 'Siri AI', its biggest assistant upgrade yet
items.summary: At WWDC, Apple revealed a far smarter Siri with better conversation, memory and app control. Reports say a custom Google Gemini model powers it behind the scenes.

items.title: Gemma 4 12B runs real multimodal AI on a laptop
items.summary: Google's new open model understands text, images and audio together and runs offline on a 16GB laptop — no internet needed. Released under a free Apache 2.0 license.

items.title: Meta adds 'AI Mode' search to Facebook
items.summary: Facebook's search now answers questions in plain language from public posts, Groups and Reels — instead of just showing a list of links.

items.title: DeepMind maps the path from AGI to superintelligence
items.summary: A 57-page paper lays out four possible routes from human-level AI to systems that could outperform whole teams of experts.
